post.description:
Backtests and price history, e.g. 1-minute BTC-USD candles between two dates: call with `granularity: 60`, `start`, `end`, `max_candles: 3000`, then follow `next_start` until it is null.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
Usage-based billing; Default request estimate: $0.0005 USD (not a fixed price). Account-specific pricing and final settlement may differ.
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

end.description: Inclusive range end, same forms as `start`. Defaults to now.

granularity.description:
Bucket length in seconds: 60, 300, 900, 3600, 21600 or 86400.

Provider reference: allowed values ["60", "300", "900", "3600", "21600", "86400"]; default 60.

max_candles.description:
Upper bound on buckets fetched in this call (300 per upstream request; requests are made sequentially to respect the 10 req/s public limit).

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 3000; default 300.

product_id.description: Trading pair id `BASE-QUOTE` as listed by `list_products`, e.g. `BTC-USD`, `USELESS-USD`. Case-insensitive; the canonical upper-case id is returned. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9]{1,20}-[A-Za-z0-9]{1,20}$.

start.description: Inclusive range start: RFC 3339 (`2026-07-24T00:00:00Z`) or a date (`2026-07-24`, midnight UTC). Defaults to `end` minus `max_candles` buckets.

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

200.description:
Historical OHLCV candles for one trading pair (`GET /products/{product_id}/candles`) at 1m, 5m, 15m, 1h, 6h or 1d granularity, oldest first. The exchange serves at most 300 buckets per request, so a wider `start`..`end` range is walked in consecutive 300-bucket windows, up to `max_candles` (default 300, max 3000 = 10 upstream requests) per call; `next_start` continues where the call stopped. Buckets without trades are omitted by the exchange (thin markets return fewer rows than the window length; a `sparse_buckets` warning says so). Values are numbers as the exchange sends them.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `candles` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `close` | number |  |
| `high` | number |  |
| `low` | number |  |
| `open` | number |  |
| `time` | number | Bucket start, Unix seconds, aligned to the granularity. |
| `time_iso` | string | Bucket start, RFC 3339 UTC (derived from `time`). |
| `volume` | number | Base-currency volume traded in the bucket. |
